verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a back-office SaaS platform, so headless or API-driven automation is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence describes only dashboard and in-app interactions, with no CLI, API, or CI tooling. Probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt all returned 404, so there is no evidence the product can be run headlessly or in CI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
